description: This file defines data types, classes, and enums related to query execution in the superset-core project, including query status, options, results, and asynchronous handling.

classes.name: QueryStatus
classes.description: Enumeration representing the various states of query execution.

classes.name: CacheOptions
classes.description: Data class for cache configuration options, including timeout and force refresh.

classes.name: QueryOptions
classes.description: Data class for specifying options for executing queries, including catalog, schema, limit, timeout, templates, caching, and dry run.

classes.name: StatementResult
classes.description: Data class representing the result of a single SQL statement execution, including SQL, data, row count, and execution time.

classes.name: QueryResult
classes.description: Data class for the overall result of a multi-statement query, including status, individual statement results, query ID, total time, cache status, and errors.

classes.name: AsyncQueryHandle
classes.description: Class for managing asynchronous query execution, with methods to check status, retrieve results, and cancel the query.

methods.name: get_status
methods.description: Returns the current status of the asynchronous query.

methods.name: get_result
methods.description: Retrieves the result of the asynchronous query, including data if successful.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Attempts to cancel the ongoing asynchronous query.
